pages.text: Unfold the attached action in one rhythm, keeping its appearance and actual effects together.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Only the connected nodes contribute; this node adds no mana fee.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.05 plus the attached action; its accompanying appearance is not charged a second time.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).
